messages:
incidents_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-region (eu-1/eu-2). 5xx ~8% over last 5m. Paging @jia_oncall. Link: https://internal.incidents/2270001111

jia_oncall: On it, looking at logs now. pulling pd alert history and checking recent deploys.

alex_sre: I’m seeing a bunch of gateway 504s + connection resets to model-hosting upstream (tcp reset, upstream=mh-eu-2). No deploys in last 20m in CI.

jia_oncall: confirmed no deploys. Traffic spiked ~10m ago from a few noisy API keys. Taking eu-2 pool out of rotation for capacity drain.

incidents_bot: Runbook reminder: follow "gateway-timeout" mitigation steps and attach notes to incident.

maria_prod: Customer impact: a handful of hosted customers reported timeouts and retries; not enterprise dedicated. We should consider cross-region fallback for non-SLA traffic.

sam_platform: We can route non-SLA requests to us-1 as temporary fallback, but that will add RTT. Quick toggle in routing config available — need ops approval to avoid unexpected cost.

jia_oncall: Implemented temporary routing rule to prefer us-1 for requests without dedicated routing tags, and scaled down batch size on eu-2 nodes to reduce queuing. Also disabled one caching layer for long tail mitigation.

alex_sre: After those changes 5xx dropped from ~8% -> ~2.1% within ~7 minutes. Good short-term. However the alert fired repeatedly during the spike — it's noisy. Current alert: 5xx_rate > 5% for 5m. It pages on small traffic volumes which causes churn.

maria_prod: +1 to tuning. We should avoid paging on small absolute counts. Also add a synthetic to detect upstream gate failures earlier.

jia_oncall: Proposed post-incident actions: (1) tune 5xx alert to include absolute request floor, (2) create a dashboard for upstream gateway latency + connection resets, (3) add runbook steps for routing fallback and customer comms. Assign: alex -> dashboard, sam -> alert rule, maria -> runbook. ETA EOD.

alex_sre: Ack. Dashboard will include panels: 5xx rate (region), upstream gateway p95/p99 latency, connection reset count, inflight batch sizes, per-pool queue length. Draft PR: https://git.internal/dashboards/pull/123

sam_platform: Working on alert rule change. Proposed PromQL-ish query (will adapt to monitoring backend):
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",region="eu"} |~ "5.."[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",region="eu"}[5m])) by (region) > 0.04)
and sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",region="eu"}[5m])) by (region) > 50
```
Set severity=critical, route to pagerduty, and add a 10m notification suppression window after an oncall ack. This should cut false pages during tiny bursts.

ops-bot: Reminder: Handoff in 30m — jia_oncall -> jia_second_shift. Please annotate oncall notes with current mitigations and links.

jia_oncall: Notes updated with actions, dashboard PR, and alert PR links. Monitoring I'll watch for 1 hour then hand off. Resolution criteria: 5xx < 1% for 30m AND no new customer error reports.

incidents_bot: RESOLVED: error-rate stabilized below 1% for 35m, no new errors reported. Incident closed. Postmortem scheduled (link: https://internal.incidents/2270001111/postmortem).

jia_oncall: Thanks team :thumbsup: Filing the follow-ups now (MON-504-eu alert tuning, DASH-uptream-gateway, RUNBOOK-routing-fallback).
